data.name: Gozalun
data.gender_notes: Gozalun is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Persian word 'gozid' meaning 'pleasing' and 'gol' meaning 'rose'. It symbolizes the joy and beauty of a rose garden. The name Gozalun carries the meaning “Joyful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Persian, Arabic. Parents who choose Gozalun usually hope their child will grow to embody joyful and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gozalun total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
